caption: The drawing depicts a carved wooden figure standing on a rectangular pedestal that has the word "CIGARS" painted on its front in white letters. The figure is dressed in a knee-length, reddish-brown garment with a sash, and its right hand is raised to chest height holding an object, while the left arm hangs at its side. The figure wears a decorative headdress in red, yellow, and brown tones, and has long, dark hair. The skin tone of the figure is depicted in a brown shade, and there is a necklace and other details painted in yellow. The pedestal on which the figure stands is painted to resemble dark brown wood. The entire colored illustration is centered on the page and surrounded by a thin rectangular line. In the lower corners of the drawing, there are two smaller line drawings, one on the left showing the figure from the back, and one on the right showing the figure in profile with height markings. The background of the drawing is a plain light beige or off-white color.
title: Cigar Store Indian
